source_memory_room.name: Context And Source Memory

agents.claim: The route opens as a public relationship mirror and earns its thesis through concrete couple behavior.

source_memory_room.summary: The creator's fixed cover line, mature handling request, car continuity, and sendability target are all preserved.
debate_records: Keep the wrong turn as the incident, the respected pause as the proof, and chai as the light return.

selected_outputs.what_success_looks_like: A viewer recognizes the space-versus-leaving distinction and sends the deck to a partner.
selected_outputs.memory_policy: Do not restore the rejected lock-check coda or introduce a second story.

story_meaning_room.name: Story Meaning Room

agents.claim: The story moves from petty irritation to a boundary, respectful restraint, voluntary return, and play.

story_meaning_room.summary: One continuous rainy evening now proves the difference between giving space and going away.
debate_records: Aachu must own the boundary and the return; Zuv's care must be visible as restraint, not management.

selected_outputs.emotional_obstacle: A request for a minute can be misheard as rejection or turned into real distance.

audience_algorithm_room.name: Audience And Algorithm Room

agents.claim: The line about a minute without distance gives couples useful, sendable language.

audience_algorithm_room.summary: The deck has a clear partner-send reason and a light final beat that prevents the middle from feeling preachy.
debate_records: Recognition peaks on slide 5; the last-biscuit joke makes the ending feel lived rather than therapeutic.

selected_outputs.distribution_reason: Send this to the partner who wants to learn the difference between giving space and going away.
selected_outputs.what_success_looks_like: A viewer thinks this is us before admiring the illustration.

contrarian_repair_room.name: Contrarian Repair Room

agents.claim: The seven observable cards read as disagreement, boundary, respected space, woman-led return, and play without relying on copy.

contrarian_repair_room.summary: The prior chronology, house/door, floating-lock, and disconnected-coda failures were removed.
debate_records: The fresh critic identified slide 5 as the weakest isolated card, but confirmed that slide 6 resolves its backward glance into a voluntary return.

selected_outputs.relationship_change: opposed and separated to boundary expressed, respected, reappraised, and repaired through play

stage_scene_room.name: Stage-Scene Gate

agents.claim: Hands, gaze, body distance, phone state, stools, cups, and biscuit all change causally across the sequence.

stage_scene_room.summary: Every emotional turn is staged as visible action before text.
debate_records: The phone moves from active to dark to absent; body distance opens and closes; the empty stools become occupied; the final biscuit restores harmless irritation.

selected_outputs.action: Aachu raises a stop palm; Zuv stops, lowers the phone, and waits.
selected_outputs.hands_or_object_movement: The phone disappears from the relationship while chai and one last biscuit enter the repair.
selected_outputs.reversal_or_payoff: Aachu returns by choice and the couple resumes playful irritation.

final_synthesis_room.name: Final Synthesis Room

agents.claim: Select the space-without-leaving route as the only story spine.

final_synthesis_room.summary: The mature thesis and light chai payoff now belong to the same incident.
debate_records: No second anecdote, home scene, or lock-check callback is needed.

selected_outputs.selected_story_lens: Mature love hears the need beneath the sentence and leaves room for a voluntary return.
selected_outputs.human_story_setup: A tiny wrong turn tests whether space will become distance.
selected_outputs.what_success_looks_like: The final line feels earned by the visible behavior.

exploration_routes.name: Give Me A Minute, Don't Go Far
exploration_routes.story_lens: Mature love does not mean never getting irritated; it means hearing the need beneath the sentence, respecting the pause, and choosing a small way back.
exploration_routes.reader_mirror: Couples who have turned a wrong turn into a silent standoff will recognize the difference between give me a minute and leave me alone forever.
exploration_routes.emotional_obstacle: One stupid wrong turn pushes Aachu and Zuv into the familiar risk that a request for space will be heard as rejection or become actual distance.
exploration_routes.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu names the boundary with a stop palm, notices that Zuv stayed without crowding, and initiates the return by pointing to chai.
exploration_routes.zuv_active_role: Zuv lowers and pockets the route phone, stops following, sits several feet away with open hands, and keeps his gaze elsewhere so she gets privacy without abandonment.
exploration_routes.proof_engine: opposite directions in parked car -> hands drop around looped route -> Aachu closes passenger door and raises stop palm -> Zuv lowers phone and waits at far end -> Aachu glances back and sees him unchanged -> she returns and points to chai -> two cups and one last biscuit restore play
exploration_routes.emotional_reversal: What first looks like withdrawal becomes proof of trust: his restraint makes room for her voluntary return, and her chai invitation turns distance back into play.
exploration_routes.payoff: They are not less irritating to each other; they are better at coming back before irritation becomes distance.
exploration_routes.distribution_reason: Send this to the partner who will say this is us and wants to learn the difference between giving space and going away.

stage_scene_gate.consequence: Aachu can return by choice, and the couple's irritation becomes play rather than rupture.
